user.title: Connect a Škoda
user.description: Create an API key in the MyŠkoda app and enter the VIN of a vehicle the key covers.

data_description.api_key: The key is shown once when it is created in the app.
data_description.vin: 17-character vehicle identification number, shown in the MyŠkoda app under vehicle details.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {vehicle} has expired or was revoked. Create a new key in the MyŠkoda app and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Replace API key
reconfigure.description: Paste a new API key for {vehicle}.

error.invalid_vin: A VIN has 17 letters and digits.
error.key_not_authorized: The API key was rejected or does not cover this vehicle.
error.vehicle_not_found: No vehicle found for this VIN.
error.rate_limited: Request quota for this vehicle is used up. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Škoda API.

init.title: Polling
init.description: The API allows about 20 requests per hour per vehicle, commands included. The integration polls faster while a charging cable is connected and backs off when the remaining quota gets low.

data_description.quota_reserve: Polling waits for the quota window to reset when fewer requests than this remain.
data_description.climate_without_external_power: Used when air conditioning is started with the switch.

key_rejected.message: The API key was rejected or no longer covers this vehicle.

rate_limited.message: Request quota for this vehicle is used up. Try again in {retry_after} s.

vehicle_busy.message: The vehicle declined the request. Try again in {retry_after} s.

operation_disabled.message: {operation} is currently disabled for this vehicle: {detail}

invalid_device.message: {device_id} is not a loaded Skoda Car API vehicle.

api_key_expiring.title: Škoda API key expires soon
api_key_expiring.description: The API key for {vehicle} expires {expires}. Create a new key in the MyŠkoda app, then open the integration and choose **Reconfigure** to paste it.

start_air_conditioning.name: Start air conditioning
start_air_conditioning.description: Starts air conditioning with an explicit target temperature.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target cabin temperature. Defaults to the climate target temperature entity.

without_external_power.name: Without external power
without_external_power.description: Allow running on the vehicle battery when not plugged in.

start_auxiliary_heating.name: Start auxiliary heating
start_auxiliary_heating.description: Starts the auxiliary heater. Requires the S-PIN.
